question:

(CPO 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. \(1∶\ \sqrt3 \)

Ratio of height = B : A = \(1∶\ \sqrt3 \)
question_hi:
माना कि A और B समान आधार वाली दो मीनारें हैं। और दोनों के आधार के बीच ठीक मध्य से, A और B के शीर्ष उन्नयन कोण क्रमशः 30° और 45° हैं। A और B की ऊँचाई का अनुपात ज्ञात करें।
(CPO 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है यानी  \(1∶\ \sqrt3 \)

ऊँचाई का अनुपात = B : A = \(1∶\ \sqrt3 \)

question:
From a point exactly midway between the foot of two towers P and Q. the angles of elevation of their tops are 30° and 60°, respectively. The ratio of the height of P to that of Q is:
(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 1 : 3.

In ∆APB = tan30° = \(\frac{1}{\sqrt3}=\frac{AP}{PB}\)
PB = AP\( \sqrt3 \)
In ∆EQB = tan60° =\( \frac{\sqrt3}{1}=\frac{EQ}{BQ}\)
 BQ = EQ/\( \sqrt3 \)
 \(\because\) PB = BQ
PB = EQ/\( \sqrt3 \)
AP\( \sqrt3 \) =  EQ/\( \sqrt3 \)
AP/EQ = 1/3
AP : EQ = 1 : 3

(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है यानी 1 : 3.

∆APB में = tan30° = \(\frac{1}{\sqrt3}=\frac{AP}{PB}\)
PB = AP\( \sqrt3 \)
∆EQB में = tan60° =\( \frac{\sqrt3}{1}=\frac{EQ}{BQ}\)
 BQ = EQ/\( \sqrt3 \)
 \(\because\) PB = BQ
PB = EQ/\( \sqrt3 \)
AP\( \sqrt3 \) =  EQ/\( \sqrt3 \)

question:
P and Q are two points on the ground on either side of a pole. The angles of elevation of the top of the pole as observed from P and Q are 60° and 30°. respectively and the distance between them is \(84\sqrt3\) m. What is the height (in m) of the pole?
(CGL MAINS 2018)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 63.

In ∆ABP = tan60° = \(\frac{\sqrt3}{1}=\frac{AB}{PB}\)
In ∆ABQ, = tan30° =\( \frac{1}{\sqrt3}=\frac{AB}{BQ}\)
For making AB equal (multiply by \(\sqrt3\))
AB : PB : BQ
\(\sqrt3\) : 1    : 3
PB + BQ = \(84\sqrt3\)
(1 + 3) unit =\(84\sqrt3\)
1 unit = 21\(\sqrt3\)
h = AB = \(\sqrt3\) unit
h = 21\(\sqrt3\) × \(\sqrt3\) = 63 m
